hazards.evidence: Furniture placement (recliner, sofa, end tables, TV stand) creates a somewhat narrowed walking path, especially near the doorway and around the TV area, which may impede walker movement.
The dark blue recliner and the light-colored armchair both appear to have soft, deep seats and may lack firm, stable armrests at an appropriate height for safe sit-to-stand transfers with a walker.
Bright sunlight through the large windows creates glare on the polished hardwood floor, which could reduce visibility of floor texture or small obstacles for someone with limited mobility.
The white interior door has a visible threshold/sill at the bottom, which could pose a tripping hazard for someone using a walker.
The doorway leading to the adjacent room appears narrow, potentially restricting the turning radius or passage of a standard walker.
